name: Caddy Proxy
description: Reverse proxy for dev server previews. Caddy listens on a single port and routes to multiple dev servers via path prefixes. Hot-reloadable via JSON API or helper scripts. Designed for Paseo integration.

listenPort.description: Port Caddy listens on (exposed via OpenShift route)

adminPort.description: Caddy admin API port for hot-reloading routes
